description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface, which provides a method for logging messages with associated metadata like priority, tag, message, and an optional Throwable. It serves as a basic contract for implementing a logging system where individual log nodes can process or forward log data.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system node capable of outputting log messages to a target or chain of targets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Implementations can define how logs are processed or propagated.
